stage1
anchors.text:
theorem stage1 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (ε τ K η : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 52 → 0 < τ → 1 ≤ K → 0 < η → 0 < N₀ → ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀,
      (primePairSetFirst (Y ^ (ε / 5))).Nonempty ∧ ∀ B ⊆ primePairSetFirst (Y ^ (ε / 5)),
        (∀ q ∈ B, ¬ GoodQ N₀ C τ Y (Y ^ K) (Y ^ (ε / 5)) q) → (B.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (primePairSetFirst (Y ^ (ε / 5))).card := by

anchors.name: stage1 application of stage
anchors.text:
obtain ⟨C, hC, hst⟩ := stage
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun ε τ K η N₀ hε hε' hτ hK hη hN => ?_⟩
  haveI : NeZero N₀ := ⟨hN.ne'⟩
  haveI : Fintype (DirichletCharacter ℂ N₀) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  choose g hg1 hg2 hg3 using stage1_prim N₀ hN
  obtain ⟨Y₁, hY₁⟩ := hst ε τ K η (Fintype.card (DirichletCharacter ℂ N₀)) hε (by linarith) hτ hK hη

anchors.name: stage_log
anchors.text:
private theorem stage_log {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in Filter.atTop, 3 / 2 * (Y ^ (ε / 5) * Real.log Y ^ 2) ≤ Y ^ (ε / 4) := by

anchors.name: stage_pow
anchors.text:
private theorem stage_pow (C : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ U : ℝ in Filter.atTop, |C| * U ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ η / 2 * U ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) := by

anchors.name: stage
anchors.text:
theorem stage :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (ε τ K η : ℝ) (R : ℕ), 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < τ → 1 ≤ K → 0 < η → ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀,
      ∀ (U F : ℝ) (m₀ a₀ : ℕ) (Ξ : Finset (Σ N : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N + 1))), admitted ε Y U m₀ a₀ → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ m₀ → (p : ℝ) ≤ Y ^ (ε / 5) ∨ (Y ^ K) ^ 400 < (p : ℝ)) →
      1 ≤ F → F ≤ U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) → Ξ.card ≤ R → (∀ ξ ∈ Ξ, ξ.2.IsPrimitive ∧ ((ξ.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ F) →
      (PPset m₀ a₀ U).Nonempty ∧ ∀ B ⊆ PPset m₀ a₀ U,
        (∀ q ∈ B, ∃ ξ ∈ Ξ, ∃ M : ℕ, M ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ BoxAll (F * U) C τ Y (Y ^ K) (fun n => ξ.2 n * J q n) M) →
        (B.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (PPset m₀ a₀ U).card := by

anchors.name: stage input applications
anchors.text:
obtain ⟨C, hC, hbox⟩ := box_of_S
  obtain ⟨Cm, hCm, hms⟩ := meanSqK
  obtain ⟨Cb, hcb⟩ := count_bad
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun ε τ K η R hε hε4 hτ hK hη => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Y₁, hY₁⟩ := hbox ε τ K hε hε4 hτ hK
  obtain ⟨Y₂, hY₂⟩ := hms ε K hε (by linarith) hK
  obtain ⟨Y₃, hY₃⟩ := bad_share Cm τ (η / (2 * (R + 1))) hCm.le hτ (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨Y₄, hY₄⟩ := count_a Formalism.HermitianLattices.Ext.PrimesInProgressions.pnt_progressions_relative_weak_holds Formalism.ZeroFreeDirichlet.excBound ε hε

anchors.name: S
anchors.text:
def S (Z y : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (κ : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊Z⌋₊, ((cN y n : ℝ) : ℂ) * κ n * ((jacobiSym (n : ℤ) q : ℤ) : ℂ)

anchors.name: J
anchors.text: def J (q n : ℕ) : ℂ := ((jacobiSym (n : ℤ) q : ℤ) : ℂ)

anchors.name: admitted
anchors.text:
structure admitted (ε Y U : ℝ) (m₀ a₀ : ℕ) : Prop where
  pos : 0 < m₀
  eight : 8 ∣ m₀
  coprime : a₀.Coprime m₀
  log_m : (1 / 4) * Real.log Y ^ 2 * Real.log m₀ ≤ Real.log U
  lo : Y ^ (ε / 6) ≤ Real.log U
  hi : Real.log U ≤ Y ^ (ε / 5) * Real.log Y ^ 2

anchors.name: MeanSq
anchors.text:
def MeanSq (C Z : ℝ) (P : Finset ℕ) (A : Set ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ y ∈ A, ∀ κ : ℕ → ℂ, (∀ n, ‖κ n‖ ≤ 1) → ∑ q ∈ P, ‖S Z y q κ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * y * Real.log y * P.card

anchors.name: Ind
anchors.text:
def Ind {N : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n.Coprime M → ψ (n : ZMod N) = f n

anchors.name: GoodC
anchors.text:
def GoodC (Q : ℝ) {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : Prop :=
  ψ ≠ 1 ∧ (N : ℝ) ≤ Q ∧ ZeroFreeBox Q ψ

anchors.name: Box
anchors.text:
def Box (Q C τ Y X : ℝ) {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : Prop :=
  GoodC Q ψ ∧ ‖logDerivLAtOne ψ‖ ≤ C * Real.log Y ∧ ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc Y X, ‖Gchi ψ y‖ ≤ y ^ (1 / 2 + τ)

anchors.name: BoxAll
anchors.text:
def BoxAll (Q C τ Y X : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (M : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N), Ind ψ f M → Box Q C τ Y X ψ

anchors.name: primePairSetFirst
anchors.text: def primePairSetFirst (z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ := PPset 8 3 (Real.exp z)

anchors.name: GoodQ
anchors.text:
def GoodQ (N₀ : ℕ) (C τ Y X z : ℝ) (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₀, BoxAll (N₀ * Real.exp z) C τ Y X (fun n => ξ n * J q n) (N₀ * q)

anchors.name: logDerivLAtOne
anchors.text:
def logDerivLAtOne {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : ℂ :=
  deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) 1 / DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ 1

anchors.name: Gchi
anchors.text:
def Gchi {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q) * ((y / n - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) + (y : ℂ) * logDerivLAtOne χ

anchors.name: cN
anchors.text: def cN (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := Λ n * min 1 (x / n)

anchors.name: Sz
anchors.text:
def Sz {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (x z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊z⌋₊, ((cN x n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q)

anchors.name: tailL
anchors.text:
def tailL {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  - logDerivLAtOne χ - ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊z⌋₊, ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q) / (n : ℂ)

anchors.name: ZeroFreeBox
anchors.text:
def ZeroFreeBox {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Q : ℝ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℂ, 1 - 1 / 400 < s.re → |s.im| ≤ Q → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0

anchors.name: PPset
anchors.text:
def PPset (m₀ a₀ : ℕ) (X : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Icc 1 ⌊X⌋₊).filter (fun q => q.Prime ∧ q % m₀ = a₀ % m₀ ∧ X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ))

anchors.name: GFiniteSplit
twist_prim
anchors.text:
theorem twist_prim :
    ∀ (f q : ℕ) [NeZero f] (ξ : DirichletCharacter ℂ f), ξ.IsPrimitive → q.Prime → q ≠ 2 → ¬ q ∣ f →
      ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (f * q), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ψ ≠ 1 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ψ (n : ZMod (f * q)) = ξ (n : ZMod f) * J q n := by

anchors.name: ind_unique
anchors.text:
theorem ind_unique :
    ∀ (N N' M : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero N'] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ N'), M ≠ 0 →
      ψ.IsPrimitive → ψ'.IsPrimitive → (∀ n : ℕ, n.Coprime M → ψ (n : ZMod N) = ψ' (n : ZMod N')) →
      (⟨N, ψ⟩ : Σ n : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ n) = ⟨N', ψ'⟩ := by

anchors.name: box_of_S
anchors.text:
theorem box_of_S :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε τ K : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < τ → 1 ≤ K → ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀, ∀ (Q : ℝ) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (q : ℕ) (κ : ℕ → ℂ),
      Y ^ (ε / 6) ≤ Real.log Q → Real.log Q ≤ Y ^ (ε / 4) → GoodC Q χ → (∀ n : ℕ, χ (n : ZMod N) = κ n * J q n) →
      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc Y (Y ^ K), ‖S ((Y ^ K) ^ 400) y q κ‖ ≤ y ^ (1 / 2 + τ) / 2) → Box Q C τ Y (Y ^ K) χ := by

anchors.name: box_of_S thresholds
anchors.text:
obtain ⟨C, hC, hk⟩ := kappaC

  obtain ⟨Y₂, h2⟩ := tailK ε K hε (by linarith) hK
  refine ⟨max (max Y₁ Y₂) 16, fun Y hY Q N _ χ q κ hlo hhi hg hχ hS => ?_⟩

anchors.name: meanSqK
anchors.text:
theorem meanSqK :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε K : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ K → ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀, ∀ (U : ℝ) (m₀ a₀ : ℕ),
      admitted ε Y U m₀ a₀ → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ m₀ → (p : ℝ) ≤ Y ^ (ε / 5) ∨ (Y ^ K) ^ 400 < (p : ℝ)) →
      MeanSq C ((Y ^ K) ^ 400) (PPset m₀ a₀ U) (Set.Icc Y (Y ^ K)) := by

anchors.name: twistK
anchors.text:
theorem twistK :
    ∀ ε A B : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 < A → 0 < B → ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀, ∀ (U : ℝ) (m₀ a₀ : ℕ), admitted ε Y U m₀ a₀ →
      ∃ nstar : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, 1 < s → Odd s → Squarefree s → s.Coprime m₀ → (s : ℝ) ≤ Y ^ A → s ≠ nstar →
        |∑ q ∈ PPset m₀ a₀ U, (jacobiSym (q : ℤ) s : ℝ)| ≤ Y ^ (-B) * ((PPset m₀ a₀ U).card : ℝ) := by

private theorem bs_block {C Z Y W : ℝ} {P : Finset ℕ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) (hYW : Y ≤ W)
    (hW2 : W ≤ 2 * Y) (h : MeanSq C Z P (Set.Icc Y W)) {κ : ℕ → ℂ} (hκ : ∀ m, ‖κ m‖ ≤ 1)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ q, w q ∈ Set.Icc Y W) :

theorem bad_share :
    ∀ C τ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → 0 < τ → 0 < η → ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀, ∀ (X Z : ℝ) (P B : Finset ℕ) (κ : ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ n, ‖κ n‖ ≤ 1) → MeanSq C Z P (Set.Icc Y X) → B ⊆ P →
      (∀ q ∈ B, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc Y X, y ^ (1 / 2 + τ) / 2 < ‖S Z y q κ‖) → (B.card : ℝ) ≤ η * P.card := by

anchors.name: count_bad

theorem count_bad :

      (∀ q ∈ B, q.Prime ∧ F < q ∧ ∃ (f : ℕ) (_ : NeZero (f * q)) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (f * q)),
        (f : ℝ) ≤ F ∧ ((f * q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Q ∧ ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ¬ ZeroFreeBox Q ψ) → (B.card : ℝ) ≤ C * Q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by

        N = f * q ∧ (f : ℝ) ≤ F ∧ ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ (N : ℝ) ≤ Q ∧ ¬ ZeroFreeBox Q ψ) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C * Q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by

theorem mainAP_lower {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (h8 : 8 ∣ M) (e : Option (DirichletCharacter ℂ M × ℝ))

theorem count_a (hP : PNTAPRelW) (hE : Formalism.ZeroFreeDirichlet.ExcBound) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ (x X : ℝ) (m₀ a₀ : ℕ),

anchors.name: MeanSquareHypW
anchors.text:
def MeanSquareHypW (ε C x₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x X : ℝ) (m₀ a₀ : ℕ) (κ : ℕ → ℂ), x₀ ≤ x → 8 ∣ m₀ →
    (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ m₀ → (p : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (ε / 5) ∨ x ^ 400 < (p : ℝ)) → a₀.Coprime m₀ → a₀ % 4 = 3 →
    (1 / 4) * Real.log x ^ 2 * Real.log m₀ ≤ Real.log X → x ^ (ε / 6) ≤ Real.log X →
    Real.log X ≤ x ^ (ε / 5) * Real.log x ^ 2 →
    (∀ n, ‖κ n‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ a b, κ (a * b) = κ a * κ b) →
    X ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ ((PPset m₀ a₀ X).card : ℝ) ∧
    (∑ q ∈ PPset m₀ a₀ X,
        ‖∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x ^ 400⌋₊, ((cN x n : ℝ) : ℂ) * κ n * ((jacobiSym (n : ℤ) q : ℤ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      C * x * Real.log x * ((PPset m₀ a₀ X).card : ℝ)

anchors.name: IsExcPair
mainAP
anchors.text:
def mainAP {M : ℕ} (e : Option (DirichletCharacter ℂ M × ℝ)) (b : ℕ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  match e with
  | none => liX X / (M.totient : ℝ)
  | some (χ₁, β₁) => (liX X - (χ₁ (b : ZMod M)).re * liX (X ^ β₁)) / (M.totient : ℝ)

anchors.name: PNTAPRelW
anchors.text:
def PNTAPRelW : Prop :=
  ∃ c₃ A₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₃ ∧ ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M], 8 ∣ M →
    ∃ e : Option (DirichletCharacter ℂ M × ℝ),
      (∀ p : DirichletCharacter ℂ M × ℝ, e = some p → IsExcPair p.1 p.2) ∧
      (e = none → ∀ (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (β₁ : ℝ), ¬ IsExcPair χ₁ β₁) ∧
      ∀ (X : ℝ) (b : ℕ), 2 ≤ X → C₀ * Real.log M * Real.log (Real.log M + 2) ≤ Real.log X → b.Coprime M →
        |(piAP X M b : ℝ) - mainAP e b X| ≤
          A₀ * (Real.exp (-(c₃ * Real.log X / Real.log M)) + Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (c₃ * Real.log X))) *
            mainAP e b X

anchors.name: excBound_of_siegelLower
anchors.text:
theorem excBound_of_siegelLower (hS : SiegelLower) : ExcBound :=
  exceptional_zero_bound_of hS lfunction_deriv_near_one

anchors.name: excBound
anchors.text: theorem excBound : ExcBound := excBound_of_siegelLower siegelLower
